rules.title: Pin actions
rules.text: Pin third-party actions to a full commit SHA.

rules.title: Least-privilege permissions
rules.text: Set explicit minimal permissions on the GITHUB_TOKEN per workflow.

rules.title: Cache dependencies
rules.text: Cache dependencies and cancel superseded runs with concurrency groups.

rules.title: No secrets in logs
rules.text: Never echo secrets and avoid pull_request_target with untrusted code.
